questions.text: How would you diagnose and fix a React app that's re-rendering far more than necessary?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: React DevTools profiler, memoization (useMemo/useCallback/React.memo), state colocation.

questions.text: Explain how you'd optimize the initial load time of a large single-page application.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Code splitting, lazy loading, bundle analysis, caching, critical CSS.

questions.text: How do you approach making a complex interactive component accessible to keyboard and screen reader users?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Semantic HTML, ARIA roles/labels, focus management, testing with a screen reader.

questions.text: Walk me through how you'd design state management for a form with many interdependent fields.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Local vs global state, derived state, validation strategy, avoiding prop drilling.

questions.text: How would you handle a race condition where two async requests can update the same UI state out of order?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Request cancellation, sequence tokens, optimistic UI with reconciliation.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you pushed back on a design that would have hurt performance or accessibility.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Collaborative pushback, data/evidence, outcome for users.

questions.text: Describe a time you inherited a messy frontend codebase. What did you do?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Prioritization, incremental refactor, balancing delivery with cleanup.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you worked closely with a designer to ship a polished feature.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Collaboration style, attention to detail, handling design-engineering tension.

questions.text: Describe a bug that was especially hard to reproduce. How did you track it down?
Tell me about a time you had to learn a new framework or tool quickly for a project.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Learning approach, applying it under time pressure, outcome.
